Let’s be clear about what this means: Trump’s hand-picked Supreme Court is silencing Black voters.

This is the Republican plan to try and hold onto power. 

We must fight back.


The Associated Press (@AP)

It's time to fight back—and stop this AI surveillance that further rigs the economy.

That starts with electing small business leaders like @ChrisPappasNH to the Senate to get it done.


Chris Pappas (@ChrisPappasNH)

At my small business, a cone of ice cream costs the same for everyone. But big corporations are using AI surveillance pricing to jack up costs.

Take it from @MarkRuffalo: A Paramount/WB merger means fewer studios and creative risks.

After Disney bought Fox, they made fewer movies. After Time Warner was sold, layoffs and price hikes followed.

This merger needs to be blocked.

Punchbowl News (@PunchbowlNews)

Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) is providing another significant financial boost to state Democratic parties as progressive and moderate candidates compete in key Senate Democratic primaries.

Despite the average family paying 20% of their income on child care in 2025, Trump has said “It's not possible for us to take care of daycare.”

To really honor Mother's Day, we must fight for our government to pass policies that actually help mothers and families.
In the richest country in the world, you shouldn't have to sell your blood to afford groceries and rent.

Trump would not be enabled to do all this damage if it weren't for the Republicans in the Senate who have bowed down to him.

History will not forget, and voters will remember during the November elections.

CEOs got a 25.6% raise last year.

Workers got 1.3%.

The economy isn't just broken—it's rigged.

Tennessee Republicans wasted no time in redistricting their House map to slice Memphis into three different districts.

They're blatantly trying to silence Black voters. Congress must step up to protect our democracy. 

cnn.com/2026/05/07/politics/…

Trump called himself "the father of IVF." But his administration wants to remove IVF protections for workers—meaning women could be fired for missing work for fertility treatments.

You can't claim to support IVF and then punish women for pursuing it.

Trump promised his White House ballroom would cost taxpayers "not one penny." Senate Republicans just slipped $1 BILLION in taxpayer funds for it into an ICE spending bill.

nbcnews.com/politics/white-h…

I’m fighting for the Working Families Guarantee:

A home you can afford.

Healthcare you can rely on.

A good job to support your family.

Childcare when and where you need it.

Time with your loved ones.

Video

Trump calls the endless war with Iran "a little journey."

I call it a broken promise.

Trump campaigned on not starting new foreign wars.

The Supreme Court temporarily restored access to mifepristone. But the truth remains that we shouldn't be one court ruling away from millions of people losing access to safe, effective medication.

I won’t stop fighting until modern reproductive healthcare is restored.

In the days before the U.S. bombed Iran, some traders placed perfectly-timed bets on the outcome—some accounts won millions.

Was that just luck? Looks like insider trading to me.

Why would the President try to take over the Fed? The answer is simple—the economy is a mess.

His plan is to seize control of the Fed, create chaos around it, and then juice the economy just enough to carry him through the midterm elections.

We see right through it.
